title: Bento Feature Grid
description: A feature section of uneven tiles on the twelve-column canvas: a tall client-portal tile, small product illustrations and one emphasised assistant tile.
summary: Six tiles placed on .column-layout, recomposed by container queries.
notes: .column-layout places columns only and never collapses on its own. The block CSS states the three compositions (7 + 5 with a two-row portal tile, then 6 + 6, then one column) in @container rules against the .container-query wrapper, and the row span is plain CSS Grid on the block's own class. Keep placement on classes, not inline styles, or the container queries cannot override it.
Each tile is its own inline-size query container, so its illustration adapts to the tile's width rather than the viewport (the portal shows file dates from 26rem).
The illustrations are aria-hidden mock-ups built from Actual CSS components; each tile's heading and text carry the content. Figures, names and the assistant prompt are sample copy.

The aura wrapper is the grid item and carries the placement; the card inside is a data-theme="dark" island. With reduced motion the aura's accent stops travelling and the shimmer stays still. Use one emphasised tile at most.
